new_jobs.title: Country Public Affairs Head, Taiwan
new_jobs.jd: **Summary** The Country Public Affairs Head, Taiwan is a senior strategic leadership role responsible for shaping the external policy environment, building trusted partnerships with government and healthcare stakeholders, and advancing Novartis priorities in support of patient access, healthcare system sustainability, and business growth. This role serves as a trusted advisor to the Country President and country leadership team, translating policy, regulatory and healthcare system developments into strategic opportunities and risks while ensuring aligned, enterprise-wide public affairs engagement. This is a high-impact opportunity for an experienced public affairs professional who wants to help shape Taiwan’s healthcare policy landscape, accelerate access to innovative medicines, and position Novartis as a trusted partner to government, industry and the broader healthcare ecosystem. **About The Role** **Key responsibilities:** * Develop and lead the Taiwan public affairs strategy in alignment with Novartis corporate priorities, country business objectives, and the regional/global public affairs agenda. * Serve as a strategic advisor to the Country President and leadership team by providing timely policy intelligence, external insights, risk assessment, and recommendations on government and healthcare system developments. * Identify and shape priority policy areas that can enable patient access to innovation, support sustainable healthcare financing, and strengthen Taiwan’s readiness for innovative therapies. * Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior government officials, policymakers, payers, healthcare leaders, patient groups, research institutions, industry associations, business chambers and other relevant stakeholders. * Lead or actively contribute to local industry and trade association platforms to advance evidence-based policy dialogue and shape an enabling environment for innovation and patient access. * Partner cross-functionally with Value and Access, Medical, Regulatory, Communications & Patient Advocacy and business teams to deliver integrated advocacy strategies for key portfolio and policy priorities. * Represent Novartis externally with credibility and integrity through government meetings, policy submissions, briefing documents, partnerships and stakeholder platforms, in line with Novartis public policy engagement standards. * Anticipate and mitigate policy, regulatory and reputational risks, including through proactive issues management and coordinated engagement with relevant internal and external stakeholders. * Provide functional leadership and develop Public Affairs talent and capabilities, across the organization, including leading, coaching and developing team members where applicable, while fostering an inspired, curious and empowered culture. **Essential Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in public policy, political science, business, law, life sciences, healthcare or a related field; Master’s degree preferred. * Significant experience in public affairs, government affairs, policy, external affairs or a related discipline in Taiwan. * Strong understanding of Taiwan’s healthcare policy environment, including patient access, healthcare financing, reimbursement, regulatory policy and innovation-related issues. * Proven ability to engage senior government officials, policymakers, healthcare stakeholders, industry associations and other external partners as a thought leader * Experience developing public affairs strategies that connect external policy priorities with business objectives and patient access goals. * Ability to advise senior business leaders, navigate ambiguity, and translate policy developments into clear strategic implications and actions. * Strong cross-functional leadership, stakeholder management, communication, judgment and integrity. * Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, medtech, life sciences or another highly regulated sector. * Professional fluency in Mandarin Chinese and excellent written and spoken English. * Demonstrated ability to use digital tools and AI responsibly to support key accountabilities and strengthen policy intelligence, stakeholder insights, scenario analysis and execution effectiveness. **Desirable Requirements** * Experience in global or multinational, complex and matrixed organizations. * Established network across Taiwan’s public sector, healthcare ecosystem, patient community, industry associations and business chambers. * Experience in market access, healthcare financing, public-private partnerships, formulary inclusion, procurement or policy reform. * Experience managing media, reputation, crisis or issues-related matters. **Key Performance Indicators** * Strategic fit and alignment of policies, regional and country political agenda with overall business strategy, depending on assigned area * Influence on associations/country policy agenda in assigned area -alignment with NVS policy * Proximity and relevance to assigned business / area * Recognized contribution to product launches * Quality of PA competencies in the assigned area * Acceptance of policies by internal/external customers; recognition of quality * Evidence of creating inspired, curious and unbossed teams * Expertise in ultilizing AI to support accountabilities. **Why Novartis:** Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture **Benefits and Rewards:** Learn about all the ways we’ll help you thrive personally and professionally. Read our handbook (PDF 30 MB)

new_jobs.title: Innovation Hub Solution Engineer

As the future of technologists and enterprise technical sellers, we guide customers from envisioning solutions to implementation. We deliver the Microsoft value story through immersive experiences, strengthening customer trust through deep engagements in exceptional environments. You will conduct discovery sessions to understand customer needs and provide strategic recommendations and best practices tailored to their specific needs. Implementing robust AI transformation solutions and optimizing the integration of various technologies and services will be key aspects of your role. Additionally, you will leverage consultancy skills to foster collaboration among technical resources and stakeholders, ensuring alignment and effective teamwork. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond **Responsibilities** * Delivering customer engagements: Prepare and deliver technical engagements including strategy sessions, envisioning workshops, architecture design sessions and rapid prototyping to demonstrate key capabilities, validate against identified risks and finalize technology choices. * AI Transformation Leadership: Be the trusted voice within the business and for customers on the latest AI platform and technology trends, guiding their transformation journeys. By prioritizing AI use cases through design thinking workshops, you will lead these journeys effectively. You will be a valued contributor to Microsoft’s strategy in your area, ensuring the Hub is proactively aligned with the right customers to drive real impact. * Strategic Vision and Planning: Own and execute a clear strategic vision for AI transformation initiatives on a set of targeted accounts, aligning with organizational goals and customer needs by collaborating and orchestrating cross-functional teams. * Solution Design and Architecture: Develop comprehensive solution architectures based on patterns and practices that are tied to customer requirements and ensure that solutions are scalable, secure and optimized for performance. By utilizing consultation skills, you will uncover and prioritize opportunities, ensuing solutions are addressing real customer needs. * Cross Platform Collaboration: Adopt a holistic approach to integrate capabilities across the entire cloud platform, identifying synergies and optimizing cross-platform integration. You will work with your peers and stakeholders to make the Innovation Hub the home of Cross Solution AI Transformation. * Technical Depth: Maintain and grow expertise in AI solutions that will include services like AI Foundry or Fabric Data platform. Develop skills in AI management and security, real-time intelligence, and application architecture to support AI transformation initiatives. Stay updated with the market trends and collaborate within technical communities. * Technical Sales and Sales Leadership: Act as a strategic change agent within the business to shape Microsoft's programs and engineering offerings. Lead the creation of scalable, field-relevant assets through internal communities. Champion Hub engagement success by connecting technical capabilities to sales opportunities and serving as a trusted voice with sales leaders and account teams. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * 5+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience * OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience * OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 3+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience * OR equivalent experience **Preferred Qualifications** * 3+ years experience as a Solutions Architect (or equivalent) including deep practical and hands-on experience with software architecture and development. * Enterprise Architect Experience: Proven experience as an Enterprise Architect, designing and implementing large-scale, complex solutions that align with business goals and technical requirements. Ability to integrate various technologies and platforms to create cohesive and scalable architectures. * Consultative Selling: Proven experience in a consultancy role, providing expert guidance and strategic recommendations to customers. Ability to navigate complex technical landscapes and deliver tailored solutions that meet specific customer needs. * Strategic & Structured Facilitator: Validated customer experience in requirements capture; prioritization; capturing evidence and impact to quantify business value; issue, risk and constraint identification with a focus on strategic goals and outcomes. * AI Solution Design Experience: Expertise in designing architectures, building, and deploying AI solutions. Experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, networking, adjacent technologies, architecture designs, migrations, and industry standards. Understanding of AI related Azure services. * Certification in relevant technologies or disciplines * Design Thinking: Proven experience of delivering design thinking; ‘ideation’; or similar context analysis / problem framing. * Highly proficient in GitHub, CI/CD and DevOps automation. * Python or other equivalent programming language. * Azure AI Foundry and Agentic AI development. new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Pixel Software, AI/ML, Data and Experiences
new_jobs.location: Banqiao District, New Taipei City, Taiwan
new_jobs.jd: Google welcomes people with disabilities. **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 2 years of experience in program management. * Experience in program management of ML or AI model training/evaluation, and software development. **Preferred qualifications:** * 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects. * Experience with both early-stage ML research and managing ML production systems (deployment and launches), as well as some familiarity with hardware lifecycle management and development practices. * Experience with the software development life cycle, and assisting in commercializing technical product launches. * Experience with program management for projects that span multiple teams geographically disparate locations. **About The Job** A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers. There is little doubt that the Android and Pixel teams make a major impact on the mobile industry. Our devices set the highest possible bar for a quality user experience and our software reaches more than a billion users worldwide. Successful Technical Program Managers on the team epitomize the philosophy that huge gains are made in the long run by focusing on the right details now. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You are equally at home describing your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade-offs in product development with engineers. Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage projects of various size and scope, identifying future opportunities, improving processes and driving the technical directions of your programs. The Google Pixel team focuses on designing and delivering the world's most helpful mobile experience. The team works on shaping the future of Pixel devices and services through some of the most advanced designs, techniques, products, and experiences in consumer electronics. This includes bringing together the best of Google’s artificial intelligence, software, and hardware to build global smartphones and create transformative experiences for users across the world. **Responsibilities** * Drive full lifecycle development of large-scale ML models while enforcing strict AI governance, safety, and compliance standards prior to ML/product deployment. * Partner with legal, policy, compliance, and engineering stakeholders to navigate competing organizational priorities, establish cross-functional alignment, and translate complex technical requirements into repeatable operational protocols. * Manage complex technical interdependencies across distinct workstreams, synchronizing data engineering pipelines with model training schedules to drive swift execution, maintain defensible release plans, and proactively mitigate key risks. * Optimize engineering efforts and maximize resource efficiency across teams by consolidating redundant baseline Large Language Model (LLM) fine-tuning initiatives and building robust, shared data pipelines across enterprise use cases. * Act as a quality advocate with internal teams and external ODM partners, managing status communications, escalating critical issues, and defining schedule inputs to deliver user experiences. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. new_jobs.jd: ***Broaden Your Horizons Through English!*** 韓商伊帕股份有限公司（Epopsoft）是一家教育科技新創公司，由曾開發出深受超過兩千萬用戶喜愛的人氣遊戲——《Crazy Arcade（爆爆王）》、 《跑跑卡丁車》、 《楓之谷》、 《FIFA Online 3》、 《I Love Coffee》等多款熱門作品的開發者共同創立。我們相信，透過英文可以體驗更廣闊的世界。我們希望在艱辛的語言學習旅途中，為每一位學習者提供一種不輕言放棄、快樂前行的方式。 2019年12月上線的《Epop 韓國版本》是一款以AI為基礎的英文學習應用程式，將經過驗證的學習方法與遊戲化設計相結合，讓枯燥乏味、令人抗拒的英文學習變得輕鬆有趣！在自由開放的氛圍中，與優秀的夥伴們攜手打造的《Epop 韓國版本 》正在快速成長——2025年12月累計下載量突破1,000萬次，更在上線僅三年內，同時登上App Store與Google Play教育類別暢銷排行榜第一名。🚀 **[Epop 的足跡]** * 2020年，獲選Google Play「年度最佳自我提升應用程式」 * 2021年，憑藉單一英文學習應用程式，在短期內完成A輪100億韓元募資 * 2023年9月，進軍日本市場（推出日本版本《Epop》） * 2024年，榮獲Google主辦之「YouTube Works Awards」最佳品牌塑造獎（Best Branding） * 2025年5月，推出繁體中文、簡體中文及西班牙文版本 * 2025年12月，全球累計下載量突破1,000萬次 **[主要職責]** * 透過活動、促銷、品牌推廣等品牌溝通工作，主導推動 Epop 在台灣市場的品牌知名度與影響力擴散。 * 深入理解 Epop 全球品牌策略，並結合台灣市場特性進行在地化落地執行。 * 透過市場調查制定在地行銷策略，並將調查成果有效融入品牌傳播活動中。 * 主導或深度參與品牌推廣活動、活動企劃、促銷方案、KOL 行銷等各類行銷專案。 * 透過專案回顧持續挖掘市場洞察，並與 Epop 的其他國家市場的行銷團隊共享經驗與見解。 **[任職資格]** * 台灣籍人士，或有 10 年以上台灣居住經歷 * 具備 5~12 年品牌行銷相關工作經驗 * 有在激烈競爭環境中成功塑造或強化品牌獨特認知度的實戰經驗 * 具備出色的品牌溝通企劃能力與執行力，作品集須有足以展現企劃能力的具體內容 * 有獨立主導品牌推廣活動企劃的經驗或相關能力 * 能夠透過邏輯性溝通推動問題解決 * 工作主動積極，有持續改善並提升工作品質的實踐經驗 * 對台灣廣告與內容生態有廣泛接觸，能夠敏銳洞察台灣市場趨勢 **[優先條件]** * 在品牌行銷領域擁有經過驗證的成功專案經驗 * 有制定品牌策略的經驗，能規劃達成目標的具體行動方案並親自推動落地 * 能有效主導跨部門及外部合作夥伴之間的協作 * 具主人翁意識，擁有獨立主導專案的豐富經驗 * 有豐富的 KOL / 網紅行銷企劃與執行經驗，並有成功案例 * 具備英文或韓文商務溝通能力 * 有在高速成長期網路或科技公司的工作經驗 **[注意事項]** * 需提交：個人履歷和作品集 * 工作地點：台北市信義區（近捷運市政府站） **[甄選流程]** * 書面審查 → 作業→ 第一次職務面試（線上） → 第二次高階主管面試（線上） → 第三次面試（視需要進行，實體） → 薪資待遇協商 → 最終錄取 **[福利]** * **自主休假制度** : Epop 團隊希望夥伴在工作時能全心投入，需要休息時也能盡情充電，因此採行不限休假次數與天數的自主休假制度。每個人都能依照自己最有效率的節奏自行安排工作與休假，並在兼顧業務進度與團隊協作的前提下自主管理行程，一起打造能發揮最佳成果的工作環境。 * **充足的餐費補助** : "為了讓夥伴不論跟誰用餐都不用擔心金額，能輕鬆自在地一起交流，提供不設金額上限的餐費補助。 * 希望大家都能透過美味的一餐補充能量，愉快地投入工作。 * **端午節・中秋節禮金** : 每逢端午節與中秋節，發放節慶禮金給 Epop 團隊的每位夥伴。 * **Epop App 使用券** : 希望讓家人、朋友等更多人也能體驗我們親手打造的 Epop 服務，因此提供App使用券。 * **健康檢查補助** : 為了照顧每位夥伴的健康，每年補助健康檢查費用。 * **除此之外，我們還有許多元的福利與人事制度正在推行中，請多多關注 Epop 的招募資訊！**

new_jobs.jd: Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. Make an Impact as an Associate Consultant As an Associate Consultant, you will collaborate within small teams to help some of the world's biggest brands answer and often implement solutions for their most challenging strategic questions. You will immediately create meaningful contributions through taking ownership of deliverables and building external relationships with clients. Focusing on technology and data, you will gain broad exposure to a range of industries, including financial services, retail, restaurants, hospitality and more. We are looking for passionate and talented professionals, who share our vision for helping our customers with their most urgent business needs, and we are recruiting for 3 career tracks that make up our team: 1. Business Experimentation Leverage Mastercard's industry-leading predictive analytics platform, Test & Learn®, and SQL to run data-backed business experiments for our clients. Consultants focus on data science-based solutions to provide insights on various business initiatives, including product launches, marketing campaigns, customer loyalty, and pricing across various industries that touch many Fortune 500 companies. Partner directly with clients to share findings and help determine which ideas are effective, as well as where, when, and how to implement them. Sampling of questions we help our customers answer: Where should a retailer open new stores to maximize profitability and minimize the cannibalization of nearby omnichannel sales? What bonus should be provided to someone opening a credit card account to entice them to use the card regularly? Team members will typically support 2-4 clients concurrently, and develop a deep understanding of client business challenges through longer term engagements (typically lasting 1-2 years). 2. Strategy & Transformation Guide clients through strategic, tactical, operational, and transformational challenges to enhance performance and operations. Our engagements cover diverse areas, including product development, marketing, customer loyalty, and innovation. Working with clients from various industries, many S&T engagements directly interface with numerous Fortune 500 companies. This role aligns with the practices of traditional management consulting firms. Sampling of questions we help our customers answer: How can a global financial services institution be successful at entering a hyper competitive new market? How can a customer improve its operating model to better achieve operational, financial and strategic goals? Team members typically support 1-3 projects concurrently, with each project lasting for approximately 8-16 weeks. 3. Marketing Services Develop strategies and lead implementation of marketing campaigns and engagements; evaluate results to drive performance on behalf of Mastercard’s clients. Provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, leveraging customer, behavioral and transactional data and defining tangible results to both the client and Mastercard. Sampling of questions we help our clients answer: How does a fintech client optimize new customer acquisition and existing customers’ life cycle value through effective targeting and communications? How does a retail client drive foot traffic into store post-covid and/or optimize their ecommerce website to increase basket-size and average spend per customer? How can a large financial institution best execute on a portfolio conversion – for example, after purchasing another issuer’s portfolio – including components like internal and external communications, market launch, and more? Team members typically support 1-3 projects from any domain and build fundamental marketing and consulting toolkit. Bring your Passion and Expertise We recruit for and value the following core competencies: Passion: Actively seeks responsibility and takes pride in delivering the highest quality results and recommendations to our clients. Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities. Analytic Excellence: Demonstrates a strong aptitude for structured problem solving, analytical and quantitative skills. Experience using data analysis or querying tools (e.g., SQL, SAS, Excel or Tableau) is an asset (particularly for Performance Analytics or Business Experimentation tracks). Business Interest: Clear interest in the world of business, and intuition for the way that companies make decisions. Rapid Growth: Eagerness to learn quickly, both through Mastercard's structured training curriculum and organic development opportunities. Teamwork: Willingness to work within small teams to produce outstanding deliverables, with a will to win attitude. Integrity: Outstanding record of academic achievement. Commitment to Mastercard's values of honesty and integrity with a willingness to embrace and learn from mistakes. Diverse Perspective: Brings a unique skillset or approach to the table in every client engagement or internal activity. Communication: Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. AI-Native Mindset (important): Ability to leverage AI for analysis, research, and real-world problem solving, with curiosity to explore new tools and turn technology into tangible outcomes. Qualifications: • Undergraduate or master’s degree with an expected graduation date between Dec 2026-July 2027 • Able to start work on 19 July 2027. • You do not require any work visa sponsorships to work in Taiwan. • Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively – both verbally and in writing – in English and the local office language (viz. Mandarin Chinese). Application Instructions: You are highly encouraged to submit a cover letter, resume and transcript (unofficial/official). After the application deadline, candidates will receive a short survey to indicate their track preferences. This information will be leveraged to best match applicants with their desired track. Track placement will indicate the types of projects where you will spend most of your time; however, we encourage and enable working across tracks to allow team members to acquire diverse skills and experiences.
